articles.summary: Gilead Sciences, Inc. (Nasdaq: GILD) announced today that its third quarter 2026 financial results and guidance will be released on Thursday, October 29, 2026 after the market closes. At 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time that day, Gilead’s management will host a webcast to discuss the company’s third quarter 2026 financial results and provide a business update. A live webcast will be available in the Investors section of www.gilead.com and will be archived there for one year. articles.summary: - Clinical Program Adds a Potentially Differentiated Oral Peptide IL-23 Receptor Inhibitor to Gilead’s Inflammation Portfolio - - HCXT-2001 Has Potential as a Monotherapy or in Combination with Other Gilead Programs to Address Unmet Needs in Immune-Mediated Inflammatory Diseases - Gilead Sciences, Inc. (Nasdaq: GILD) today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire an oral IL-23R inhibitor program, including lead asset HCXT-2001, from PepStar Therapeutics Limited, a privately held, clinical-stage biotechnology company. Key Highlights HCXT-2001 is an investigational, clinical-stage, oral, macrocyclic peptide inhibitor of IL-23R with an extended half-life, offering a potentially differentiated approach to oral IL-23 pathway inhibition. IL-23R is a clinically validated target in immune-mediated inflammatory diseases, including Inflammatory Bowel Diseases (IBD), with potential applications in psoriasis.
